title: The Clock That Stopped
idea: The Clockwork Club finds a strange map that leads them inside the town clock tower, which has been silent for fifty years.
premise: A map hidden in a library book about clocks reveals a secret message in heat-reactive ink. Following it, Milo, Zara and Gus sneak into the stopped clock tower at night to find the 'twelfth gear' and the key that can wake the tower up.
theme: Curiosity and teamwork can restart things everyone else gave up on.
final_payoff: The friends find the hidden twelfth gear (thanks to Gus's runaway cookie), turn the key, and the tower chimes across Tickton for the first time in fifty years.

parts.title: The Moving Map
parts.logline: Milo swears a map he found just moved; Zara proves it is heat-reactive ink revealing a secret message about the clock tower.
parts.hook: Milo slams a dusty map on the table: 'This map just MOVED!'
parts.escalation: Gus's hot cocoa reveals golden hidden lines and a riddle: the key is in the twelfth gear.
parts.mini_payoff: Zara explains the 'moving' map: heat-reactive ink.
parts.cliffhanger: The clock tower, silent for fifty years, chimes once - right after they decide to go in tonight.

parts.title: The Twelfth Gear
parts.logline: Inside the dark tower the friends count only eleven gears, until Gus's runaway cookie reveals the hidden twelfth gear and its key.
parts.hook: In the dark, Gus's flashlight dies: 'And I can hear ticking.'
parts.escalation: Zara counts the gears: there is no twelfth gear. The map lied?
parts.mini_payoff: Gus's cookie rolls into a gap behind the clock face, revealing the twelfth gear and an old brass key.
parts.recap: Previously: the moving map, the riddle of the twelfth gear, and the tower's impossible chime.
